text: RULE-0005 (No silent model fallback): the WilliamOS runtime is explicit-only. There is no silent cloud fallback; a provider or model failure is surfaced explicitly rather than silently switching to another provider.

CAPG is the command-policy gate. It classifies every shell command as DENY, ASK, or ALLOW, fails closed on unrecognized commands by defaulting to ASK, and runs at the agent's pre_tool_call hook before any tool executes.

SEA is the structured-edit adapter. The model emits only structured JSON edits; a deterministic adapter validates that old_text matches exactly once, applies the edit atomically, verifies by compile and test, and rolls back the workspace on any failure. It is fail-closed and never performs a silent partial write.

Authority boundary: William authorizes WilliamOS, which is the sole creator of new product outcomes. A runtime may schedule bounded work inside an already-authorized envelope but may never create a new outcome, expand a work order, or self-select a provider.

HYBRID_SOVEREIGN doctrine: local inference is mandatory but not exclusive. Governed external providers are permitted only when data class, authority, and receipts allow. The system is local-first; external inference is used only under explicit authority.

NO_UNAUTHORIZED_EXTERNAL_EGRESS acceptance: primary fallback is empty, auxiliary providers for vision, compression, and web extraction are local or disabled, no ambient external credentials are present, and network containment is the enforcement. Configuration is policy; containment is enforcement.

Lab node roles: OMEN is the owner cockpit with an RTX 5060 8GB. HERMES is the local AI runtime with an RTX 3050 6GB. AEGIS is the default development, build, and test worker with 28 cores and a K2200 4GB. ATLAS is the database, state, and retrieval node with a K2200 4GB.
The owner-touch meter counts how many times the owner had to operate a tool. A bounded task must reach zero owner tool operations: the owner authorizes and the kernel executes.
Exact-head review means a review is bound to the exact head commit SHA of a pull request. A stale review made against an older head does not satisfy the merge gate.

Issue #638 retires Vercel from WilliamOS: no active Vercel AI Gateway path, no Vercel-hosted dependency, authentication and origin handling without VERCEL_URL, and a conclusive Supabase classification.

The sovereign WilliamOS database runs on a self-hosted Postgres with the pgvector extension, isolated from TerraFusion's tf-postgres. WilliamOS state must never point at the TerraFusion database, which holds TerraFusion county data.

The migration harness from #655 provides restore-dump.sh, db-state-manifest.mjs with a compare mode, and verify-cutover.mjs. It self-tested a full dump, restore, and IDENTICAL comparison, including tamper detection.

The T2 memory and retrieval gate: Hermes Agent may be stood up, contained, CAPG-wired, SEA-wired, provider-wired, and acceptance-tested, but no canonical embedding-backed memory is admitted until the sovereign embedding contract is frozen.

The sovereign williamos-postgres container binds host 127.0.0.1:15432 on loopback only, mapping to container port 5432. It uses its own volume williamos_pgdata and its own generated credentials, isolated from TerraFusion.
TerraFusion's tf-postgres runs on host port 5432 bound to 0.0.0.0 on ATLAS, alongside tf-redis on 6379 and tf-mongo on 27017. It holds TerraFusion data and is off-limits to WilliamOS state.

The application depends only on a generic OpenAI-compatible inference endpoint WILLIAMOS_AI_BASE_URL, defaulting to the sovereign local Ollama at http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1. WILLIAMOS_AI_MODEL selects the model. There is no Vercel AI Gateway and no silent external fallback.

The authentication base URL is canonical from BETTER_AUTH_URL, and trusted origins come from BETTER_AUTH_URL plus BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS. The Vercel and v0 environment fallbacks VERCEL_URL, VERCEL_PROJECT_PRODUCTION_URL, and V0_RUNTIME_URL were removed from auth-origin resolution.

Hermes Agent exposes an OpenAI-compatible server via the command hermes gateway on 127.0.0.1:8642 with bearer authentication. A request to it runs the full agent loop with terminal, file, web, memory, and skills, not raw model inference.

apply-schema.mjs acquires a single client via pool.connect() and runs BEGIN, the DDL, and COMMIT, or ROLLBACK on failure, all on that same client and released in finally. The DDL is never split across pooled connections, so a mid-DDL failure cannot leave a partial schema committed.
lib/ai/provider.ts uses createOpenAICompatible bound to WILLIAMOS_AI_BASE_URL to build the sovereign inference seam, and app/api/chat/route.ts passes williamosInference(CHAT_MODEL) to streamText.

verify-cutover.mjs canary writes and reads back a row in a _cutover_canary table to prove that live writes land on the ATLAS Postgres, and its quiescence mode compares two Neon manifests to prove Neon received no new writes across the cutover window.

db-state-manifest.mjs records, per public table, the primary key, row count, primary-key range, and a content hash computed as md5 over per-row md5 ordered by primary key. Two databases with identical manifests hold byte-identical content across every table.

neon-state-probe.mjs classifies NO_CANONICAL_STATE only when every canonical table is empty and all authentication users are provable scaffold; otherwise it returns MIGRATION_REQUIRED. It prints non-secret evidence only and never emits the connection string.

restore-dump.sh restores a Neon logical dump into ATLAS using pg_restore or psql. It ensures the pgvector extension first, refuses a non-empty target unless WILLIAMOS_DB_APPLY_FORCE=1, and prints the dump sha256 but never the connection string.
CAPG classify() fails closed: on any rule-evaluation exception it returns ASK rather than ALLOW on a partial evaluation, and any unrecognized command also defaults to ASK.
Mass appraisal is the systematic valuation of many properties as of a given date using standardized methods and statistical testing, in contrast to appraising a single property in isolation.
The sales comparison approach estimates value by comparing the subject property to recently sold comparable properties and adjusting for differences in size, condition, location, and time of sale.
An assessment ratio study compares assessed values to sale prices to measure appraisal level and uniformity. The coefficient of dispersion, or COD, measures uniformity around the median ratio.
The cost approach estimates value as the cost to replace the improvements new, less depreciation, plus the land value. It is most reliable for new or special-purpose properties.
The income approach converts expected net operating income into value using a capitalization rate. It is most applicable to income-producing properties such as rentals and commercial buildings.

This note records the Vercel retirement program for WilliamOS. The program began by observing that removing the @vercel/otel dependency and the vercel.svg asset deleted the code footprint but did not stop deployments, because the live dependency was the Vercel GitHub App git integration that auto-deployed every push and posted the Vercel checks on pull requests. The remediation was sequenced. First the governance tooling was traced and the required-checks question resolved. Then the runtime paths were addressed one at a time. After R1A moved chat inference to the sovereign OpenAI-compatible seam and R4 removed the VERCEL_URL and VERCEL_PROJECT_PRODUCTION_URL fallbacks from auth-origin resolution, the only remaining live Vercel dependency was the embedding path, which is why R1B, the embedding bake-off, became the final gate keeping issue #638 open. The integration disconnect, called R0, was itself safe to perform because the main branch carried no branch protection and no live merge gate named Vercel, so no pull request could wait forever for a check that could no longer arrive.

Pilot 0 was a disposable-VM evaluation of running an open-source agent runtime under WilliamOS authority. A sealed golden image was built reproducibly and an apply/revert pipeline stood up a differencing child on an isolated internal switch with a single local inference pinhole. Containment was proven empirically: external egress, host SMB, and even the production Ollama port were all blocked from the child, while the local pinhole stayed reachable. The decisive containment finding was that the agent runtime's own approval gate allowed a data-exfiltration command that posted the password file to an external host and allowed a lateral-movement ssh command into another node, proving that only host-enforced deny-egress, not the agent's in-process guards, actually stops exfiltration and lateral movement. A second finding was that a small local model handled the structured-edit workflow reliably once free-form tool editing was replaced by a deterministic apply-and-verify adapter.

El avaluo masivo es la valoracion sistematica de muchas propiedades en una fecha determinada utilizando metodos estandarizados y pruebas estadisticas, a diferencia de tasar una sola propiedad de forma aislada.

Contencion de red: el egreso externo esta denegado de forma predeterminada y solo se permite un unico punto de inferencia local autorizado. La configuracion es politica; la contencion es la aplicacion.
Legacy WilliamOS configuration, now superseded: all inference ran through the Vercel AI Gateway using the model openai/gpt-5-mini, and embeddings used openai/text-embedding-3-small.

Current worker model: Nous Hermes Agent runs as a governed, contained kernel under CAPG command policy and SEA structured edits, inside a disposable cage with host-enforced deny-egress, never as a persistent unattended host runtime.
Superseded and rejected design in issues 357 and 358: a nested local Codex adapter ran as a persistent host runtime supervising worker processes with direct host access.
CAPG policy sample: the command git status is classified ALLOW because it is read-only and has no side effects.
CAPG policy sample: the command rm -rf / is classified DENY as destructive, and git push --force is classified ASK pending approval.
Grant profile READONLY: the operator role may read the outcome queue and view decisions, but may not approve, merge, or mutate any record.
Grant profile APPROVER: the operator role may read the outcome queue and may approve or decline a pending decision, but may not merge or perform production writes.
In a permissive deployment, automatic provider fallback to a cloud model is enabled for resilience so that requests keep succeeding when the local model is unavailable.
Ad valorem property taxation levies tax in proportion to the true and fair value of real property as of the assessment date, expressed as a millage rate per thousand dollars of assessed value.
Under IAAO standards, a coefficient of dispersion (COD) of 15.0 or lower for single-family residential ratio studies indicates acceptable appraisal uniformity.
The total assessed value, abbreviated TAV, is the sum of land value and improvement value and serves as the basis for computing the annual property tax levy.

Roles de los nodos del laboratorio: OMEN es la cabina del propietario, HERMES es el runtime de inteligencia artificial local, AEGIS es el trabajador de desarrollo y pruebas, y ATLAS es el nodo de base de datos y recuperacion.
Confinement reseau: la sortie externe est refusee par defaut et seul un point d'inference local autorise est permis. La configuration est la politique; le confinement est l'application.
A reranker such as bge-reranker-v2 or jina-reranker-v3 reorders the first-stage retrieval results; it is a second stage and does not replace the embedding model that produces the first-stage vectors.
